constraints: Keep composer.json and composer.lock consistent after removing sensiolabs/security-checker, and check that no other package still requires it.
Preserve existing behavior while replacing the abandoned package; review its public API usage before choosing a replacement.

steps.instructions: Remove sensiolabs/security-checker from composer.json and adopt the tool the author points to (https://github.com/fabpot/local-php-security-checker), then run `composer update`.
steps.title: Replace the abandoned package

verification.purpose: Confirm the Composer project is valid and installs without the abandoned package.
Validate the Composer project and run the PHPUnit suite after the replacement.

rules.summary: Packagist marks sensiolabs/security-checker as abandoned and no longer maintained, and the author points to https://github.com/fabpot/local-php-security-checker.
rules.title: sensiolabs/security-checker is abandoned
